Name: Villager Name Replacer (Outdated)
Author: OkaMoez
Description:
[size=4]This mod is no longer being updated. 
The functionality has been taken up and improved on in Apollyon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url][/size].
[size=4]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]
[s]This mod lets you selectively replace almost any/all villager names in the Stardew Valley using Pathoschild's Content Patcher.  It shouldn't interfere with other mods unless they also modify or add dialogue or names.




[size=5]Installation:[/size]
Get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and install it according to his instructions.
Download the Villager Name Replacer.[size=1] (It has just about everyone.)[/size]
Unpack archive to your .../StardewValley/Mods folder.
Open .../StardewValley/Mods/Villager Name Replacer/content.json with a text editor. (Notepad++ recommended)
Change the "VillagerName" "Value" fields to your desired name. (more details in content.json)
Save changes and start the game.
Enjoy.

[size=5]Deletion:[/size]
Removing it is as simple as taking it out of your mods folder. (delete or move)


[size=5]
Current Issues:[/size]
Please leave a message/bug report if you encounter anywhere a name isn't changing.
The .json files have some minor format issues that don't affect SMAPI, but I will clean up in the next update.
As far as I know this only will work well in English.  While playing in other languages, dialogue lines that include names might show up entirely in English, since I didn't make it language specific.  The fix is probably really simple, but I made this is about 30 min at 1 am and couldn't be bothered to figure it out then.  Maybe in the future. 



[size=2]Legacy versions handled a single character at a time.  The new version should work just as well if not better, but the following NPC's are supported in their own solo mod files under misc:
Abigail
Clint
Penny
Sam
Sebastian
Shane[/size][/s]

Downloads.Description: Has options for almost all townspeople, and allows multiple renames at the same time.  Rename one person, a few, or everyone.
